config.script:
dbConnection = self.custom.dbConnection
	table = mes_core.model.statereasonTable(dbConnection)
	self.custom.dataReason = table.selectCustom(columns = ['ID','ReasonName'],where_clause = 'ReasonCode NOT IN (?,?) AND SubReasonOf != -1 order by ReasonCode asc',where_args = [3,10000])

onChange.script:
try :
		table = mes_core.model.statereasonTable(self.custom.dbConnection)
		data = table.selectCustom(columns=['ReasonName','ReasonCode'],where_clause = 'ID = ?',where_args = [self.custom.new.ReasonID])
		self.custom.new.ReasonName = data.getValueAt(0,0)
		self.custom.new.ReasonCode = data.getValueAt(0,1)
	except:
		self.custom.new.ReasonName = ''
		self.custom.new.ReasonCode = ''

config.script:
import json
	logger = system.util.getLogger("AssignedReason.Test")
	logger.info("Inicio solicitud de division de evento")
	
	#Parametros seleccionados
	cutDate = self.view.custom.new.startDate
	reasonId = self.view.custom.new.ReasonID
	startDate = self.view.custom.old.startDate
	endDate = self.view.custom.new.endDate
	eventID = self.view.custom.old.eventID


    # Verificar fecha de división
	if cutDate <= startDate or cutDate >= endDate:
		alerts.noSelectionOption(function = 'una fecha de division valida')
	elif reasonId == '' or reasonId == None:
		alerts.noSelectionOption(function = 'una razon para asignar')# Verificar si la razón seleccionada es "Generic unplanned"
	else:
 		alerts.confirmAction(title = 'Dividir evento', message = 'dividir el evento con ID {}.'.format(eventID), action = 'cutEvent')
	logger.info("Fin solicitud de division de evento")

messageHandlers.script:
db = self.view.custom.dbConnection
	table = mes_core.model.statehistoryTable(db)
	row_id = self.view.custom.old.eventID
	set_values = {'StartDateTime':self.view.custom.old.startDate,'EndDateTime':self.view.custom.old.endDate}
	table.updateID(row_id,set_values)
	table.insert(stateReasonID = self.view.custom.new.ReasonID,
				startDateTime = self.view.custom.new.startDate,
				reasonName = self.view.custom.new.ReasonName,
				reasonCode = self.view.custom.new.ReasonCode,
				endDateTime = self.view.custom.new.endDate,
				note = self.view.custom.new.Note,
				runID = self.view.custom.new.runID,
				nodeID = self.view.custom.new.nodeID)
	alerts.actionSuccess(title='Evento dividido', message = 'Evento dividido exitosamente')
	system.perspective.closePopup('eventEditDivision')
